name: Navigation Shortcut
summary:
*   Role: Product Manager at HotWax Commerce.
*   Audience: Enthusiastic Retailer (cares about improvements/features).
*   Goal: Summarize a cluster of updates into a cohesive release note entry.
*   Input: A single PR/Issue cluster regarding "Mount Fast Travel in Transfers".

    *   *Feature:* Integrating "Fast Travel" search utility into the Transfers application.
    *   *Problem:* Operators currently have to return to the Launchpad or manually copy/paste URLs to switch between different HotWax admin applications.
    *   *Solution:* Added the Fast Travel entry point (Cmd/Ctrl+K) directly into the Transfers app shell.
    *   *Impact:* Faster navigation between configured admin apps without leaving the current application.

    *   *Structure for Features:* Problem, Solution, Impact.
    *   *Simpler is better.*
    *   *Active voice.*
    *   *Granular but concise (3-4 sentences total).*
    *   *Tone:* Professional, utility-focused.
    *   *No AI Slop:* Avoid "enhanced", "streamlined", "seamless", "robust".
    *   *No Exclamation Points:* Use periods only.
    *   *No dev-time bugs:* Don't mention build issues or code refactoring; focus on the polished feature.
    *   *Standalone Bug Fix
